plan.notes: Source: TMCC official catalog 'Psychology, AS' (https://catalog.tmcc.edu/degrees-certificates/psychology-as/), 'Recommended Course Schedule' plan-of-study grid (Psychology Career Map), hand-transcribed 2026-10-02. The catalog defines its plan footnote 4 on this page as 'Any transferable science course' — those slots are modeled as choice slots with that definition; see advisor. The plan footnote numbered 5 in the schedule grid is not defined on this page — those slots are modeled as choice slots with an honest 'not defined on this page; see advisor' note. Blank unnamed rows (1st: 3 units; 3rd: 3 units; 4th: 5 and 3 units) are modeled as generic elective slots (see advisor). Designed as a university transfer program substantially meeting the first two years of study for a B.S. in Psychology at UNR. Per-course prerequisites are not listed in the schedule grid. This program can be completed online but may require in-person assignments or exams.
